leadText:
Volume 44 is the 44th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume two of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".
plainText:
Volume 44 is the 44th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume two of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".

==Blurb==
And now Team Plasma member N has the nerve to tell Black he isn’t in touch with his Pokémon’s feelings. Them’s fighting words—literally! Which of the two Trainers has the best relationship with his Pokémon? And will that help him win a heated Pokémon battle against the other?

Then, who kidnapped Black’s Munna...?!
